read.reason: Exact private development requests may read their bound contained workspace; this grants no provider-read authority.

disclosure.reason: The development catalog allows exact request-bound target material to enter the already-active selected host task. This relies on an ambient host transport boundary Soter neither grants nor verifies and grants no onward or third-party disclosure authority.

write.reason: Exact private development requests may write only inside their bound contained worker workspace.

dispatch.reason: Exact private evaluation requests may dispatch fresh contained host workers through a separately trusted host executor.

destructive.reason: The development catalog prohibits destructive effects.
